DLG-SC-LOC-025-09-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-025-09-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 読経の見学をご希望でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-09-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like to observe the sutra chanting?

DLG-SC-LOC-025-09-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-025-09-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。今から十分だけ聞いて帰りたいです。扉の外まで来ましたが、途中から入ってもよいのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-09-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 十分だけ読経を聞きたいと途中入室可否を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-09-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I'd like to listen for just ten minutes from now and then leave. I've come as far as the outside of the door, but may I enter after it has started?
DLG-SC-LOC-025-09-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you want to listen to the sutra chanting for ten minutes and ask whether entry partway through is allowed. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-025-09-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-025-09-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 今の回は、始まった後の入室をご案内していません。次の回からのご案内になります。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-09-001-SHARED-03.translation: For the current session, we do not admit visitors after it has started. We can admit you from the next session.

DLG-SC-LOC-025-09-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-025-09-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 十分だけなら入れると思っていましたが、時間の短さでは決まらないのですね。扉はまだ開けていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-09-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 短時間希望でも途中入室不可と理解し扉は未開放と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-09-001-SHARED-04.translation: I thought I could enter if it was only for ten minutes, but it isn't determined by how short my stay is. I haven't opened the door yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-025-09-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show you understand that even a short visit does not allow entry partway through, and say the door is still unopened. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-025-09-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-025-09-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 次の回を待たれるなら、受付の案内時刻をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-09-001-SHARED-05.translation: If you will wait for the next session, please check the admission time at reception.

DLG-SC-LOC-025-09-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-025-09-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 帰りの列車までの余裕がないので、今日は待てません。今の読経を早く終えてもらうようなお願いはしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-09-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 帰り列車の時間から次回待機できず儀式短縮も頼まない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-09-001-SHARED-06.translation: I don't have enough time before my train home, so I can't wait today. I won't ask for the current chanting to be ended early.
DLG-SC-LOC-025-09-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you cannot wait for the next session because of your return train and will not ask for the ceremony to be shortened. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-025-09-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-025-09-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 別の機会に、開始前にお越しいただくこともできます。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-09-001-SHARED-07.translation: You can also come before the start on another occasion.

DLG-SC-LOC-025-09-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-025-09-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: そうします。次は読経の長さだけでなく、受付から案内までの時間も含めて予定を立てたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-09-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 別機会では読経以外の受付案内時間を含め予定したいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-09-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll do that. Next time, I'd like to plan for the time from reception to admission as well as the length of the chanting.
DLG-SC-LOC-025-09-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that on another visit you will allow time for reception and admission, not only the chanting. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-025-09-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-025-09-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 予定される日に、現在の案内をご確認ください。毎日同じとは限りません。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-09-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please check the current information for the day you plan to visit. It may not be the same every day.

DLG-SC-LOC-025-09-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-025-09-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今日の時刻をそのまま次の訪問日へ使わず、来る日が決まってから案内を確かめます。今日は境内を静かに見て帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-09-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 当日時刻を別日へ流用せず訪問日決定後確認し本日は静かな見学だけにする。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-09-001-SHARED-10.translation: I won't simply use today's times for my next visit. I'll check the information after deciding the date. Today I'll just quietly look around the temple grounds and leave.
DLG-SC-LOC-025-09-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will not reuse today's times for another date, will check after choosing your visit date, and will only tour the grounds quietly today. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-025-09-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-025-09-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。それでは、またの機会にお待ちしております。お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-09-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We look forward to seeing you another time. Take care on your way home.

DLG-SC-LOC-025-10-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-025-10-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お線香をお求めですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-10-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like to buy incense?

DLG-SC-LOC-025-10-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-025-10-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 今日は求めずに相談したいです。煙のそばにいるとつらくなるので、線香を供えずに静かに参拝できる場所があれば知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-10-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 線香を求めず煙を避けて参拝できる場所を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-10-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like to ask for advice without buying any today. Being near smoke is uncomfortable for me, so I'd like to know if there's somewhere I can worship quietly without offering incense.
DLG-SC-LOC-025-10-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about a place to worship away from smoke without buying incense. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-025-10-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-025-10-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 無理に煙の近くへ進まなくても結構です。この中庭から離れた外側をご案内できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-10-001-SHARED-03.translation: You don't have to force yourself to approach the smoke. We can show you an outer area away from this courtyard.

DLG-SC-LOC-025-10-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-025-10-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。連れは線香を供えたいので、私のために連れの希望まで止める必要はありません。私は外側で待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-10-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 同行者の線香希望は止めず本人だけ外側待機を選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-10-001-SHARED-04.translation: Thank you. My companion wants to offer incense, so there's no need to stop them from doing so on my account. I'll wait in the outer area.
DLG-SC-LOC-025-10-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Choose to wait outside yourself without stopping your companion from offering incense. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-025-10-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-025-10-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: お連れの方とは、待つ場所を先にお決めください。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-10-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please agree with your companion beforehand where you will wait.

DLG-SC-LOC-025-10-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-025-10-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 外側のベンチで待つと伝えました。線香が消えるまでそばで我慢すると約束したわけではないことも話します。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-10-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: ベンチ待機を連れへ伝え煙そばで我慢する約束ではないと明示する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-10-001-SHARED-06.translation: I've told them I'll wait on the bench in the outer area. I'll also explain that this doesn't mean I've promised to endure being beside the incense until it burns out.
DLG-SC-LOC-025-10-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Tell your companion you will wait on the bench and make clear you have not promised to endure waiting near the smoke. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-025-10-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-025-10-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ベンチは通路から外れた位置にあります。ご不安があれば、近くの職員へお声がけください。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-10-001-SHARED-07.translation: The bench is away from the passage. If you're concerned, please speak to a nearby staff member.

DLG-SC-LOC-025-10-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-025-10-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: そこまで案内していただけますか。煙を避けるつもりで、立入りできない場所へ自分で移るのはやめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-10-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 許可不明場所へ自己移動せず煙を避ける案内を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-10-001-SHARED-08.translation: Could you show me the way there? I won't move into an area where entry is prohibited on my own in an attempt to avoid the smoke.
DLG-SC-LOC-025-10-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask to be guided away from the smoke instead of entering an area on your own when permission is unclear. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-025-10-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-025-10-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: こちらの通路からご案内します。お連れの方がお戻りになるまで、ここでお待ちいただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-10-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll guide you along this passage. You may wait here until your companion returns.

DLG-SC-LOC-025-10-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-025-10-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 場所が分かりました。ここから静かに手を合わせ、連れが戻るのを待ちます。線香を使わないことを自分で責めずに過ごせます。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-10-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 案内位置で線香なしの静かな参拝と同行者待機を選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-10-001-SHARED-10.translation: I understand where it is now. I'll quietly put my hands together in prayer here and wait for my companion to return. I can spend the time without blaming myself for not using incense.
DLG-SC-LOC-025-10-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Choose quiet worship without incense and waiting for your companion at the guided location. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-025-10-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-025-10-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: どうぞ無理のない形でお過ごしください。それでは、失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-10-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please spend your time in a way that is comfortable for you. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-025-11-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-025-11-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 自転車が見当たらないとのご相談ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-11-001-SHARED-01.translation: You're here because you can't find your bicycle, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-025-11-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-025-11-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい、盗まれたと思って来ました。ですが、今、同居人から連絡があり、私が昨日貸した自転車をまだ預かっているそうです。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-11-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 盗難と思った初相談中に昨日借主から保管連絡が来たと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-11-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes, I came because I thought it had been stolen. But my housemate has just contacted me and says they still have the bicycle I lent them yesterday.
DLG-SC-LOC-025-11-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: During your initial inquiry about suspected theft, explain that the person who borrowed it yesterday has contacted you to say they still have it. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-025-11-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-025-11-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 昨日、貸したことについては覚えていらっしゃいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-11-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you remember lending it yesterday?

DLG-SC-LOC-025-11-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-025-11-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 思い出しました。夕方に貸しましたが、今朝には戻したと思い込んでいました。返した時刻までは約束していませんでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-11-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 貸出事実を思い出し朝返却と思込み返却時刻は未合意と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-11-001-SHARED-04.translation: I've remembered now. I lent it in the evening, but assumed it had been returned by this morning. We hadn't agreed on a return time.
DLG-SC-LOC-025-11-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you remember lending it, had assumed it was returned by morning, and had not agreed a return time. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-025-11-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-025-11-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: では、先ほど盗まれたとお話しになった点は、現在の確認内容と合わせて記録します。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-11-001-SHARED-05.translation: Then we'll record your earlier statement that it was stolen together with the facts now confirmed.

DLG-SC-LOC-025-11-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-025-11-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 盗まれたと決めて話したことを訂正します。同居人を犯人だと申し上げる話でもありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-11-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 盗難断定を訂正し借主を犯人とする発言でないと明示する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-11-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'd like to correct my earlier definite statement that it was stolen. I'm not saying that my housemate is a culprit either.
DLG-SC-LOC-025-11-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Correct the definite assertion of theft and make clear you are not accusing the borrower of being a culprit. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-025-11-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-025-11-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 自転車がご本人の物と確かめられる情報はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-11-001-SHARED-07.translation: Do you have information confirming that this is your bicycle?

DLG-SC-LOC-025-11-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-025-11-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 同居人が車体の番号を読み、私の控えと一致しました。色だけで、別の自転車を見つけたと思ったのではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-11-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 借主が読んだ車体番号と本人控え一致で所有物を確認したと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-11-001-SHARED-08.translation: My housemate read the frame number, and it matched my record. I didn't just go by the color and think another bicycle had been found.
DLG-SC-LOC-025-11-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you confirmed it is yours because the frame number read by the borrower matched your own record. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-025-11-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-025-11-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その確認結果を担当へ伝えます。返してもらう予定は、当事者で確認できていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-11-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll tell the person responsible what you've confirmed. Have you agreed between yourselves when it will be returned?

DLG-SC-LOC-025-11-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-025-11-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今夜戻してもらうことになりました。まだ手元へ戻ったとは言えませんが、場所と相手が分かったので、そのまま報告します。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-11-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 今夜返却予定だが現受領でなく所在相手確認済みとして報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-11-001-SHARED-10.translation: They will return it tonight. I can't say I've received it back yet, but I know where it is and who has it, so I'll report those facts as they are.
DLG-SC-LOC-025-11-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Report that return is planned for tonight, you have not yet received it, and its location and holder are confirmed. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-025-11-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-025-11-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 確認内容をお伺いしました。それでは、必要な案内を担当へ確認します。少しお待ちください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-11-001-SHARED-11.translation: I've heard the confirmed details. I'll now check with the person responsible about any necessary guidance. Please wait a moment. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-025-12-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-025-12-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 目の薬のご相談は、薬剤師へおつなぎできます。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-12-001-SHARED-01.translation: We can put you in touch with a pharmacist about eye medication.

DLG-SC-LOC-025-12-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-025-12-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: お願いします。コンタクトレンズを使っています。以前の目薬を今も使ってよいか、自分で決めずに聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-12-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: レンズ利用中の以前の目薬について自己判断せず薬剤師相談を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-12-001-SHARED-02.translation: Please do. I use contact lenses. I'd like to ask whether I can still use my previous eye drops, rather than deciding for myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-025-12-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask to consult a pharmacist rather than decide for yourself about your old eye drops while using contact lenses. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-025-12-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-025-12-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: お使いになる方は、ご本人ですね。以前の品はお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-12-001-SHARED-03.translation: You are the person who will use them, correct? Do you have the previous product with you?

DLG-SC-LOC-025-12-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-025-12-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 自分用です。品は家にありますが、箱の名前を控えました。レンズを使い始めたのは最近なので、前と事情が変わりました。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-12-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 本人使用と品名控えを示しレンズ開始で状況が変わったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-12-001-SHARED-04.translation: They're for me. The product is at home, but I've noted the name on the box. I only started using lenses recently, so my circumstances have changed.
DLG-SC-LOC-025-12-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say they are for yourself, show the recorded product name, and explain that starting contact lenses has changed the situation. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-025-12-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-025-12-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 商品と現在のご利用状況を、薬剤師へお伝えします。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-12-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll tell the pharmacist about the product and your current use.

DLG-SC-LOC-025-12-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-025-12-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: レンズを付けている時間は仕事中です。外した後の話と、付けたまま使う話を一緒にせず、薬剤師へ説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-12-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 仕事中の装用時と外した後の使用質問を分けて説明すると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-12-001-SHARED-06.translation: I wear the lenses during work. I'll explain to the pharmacist separately about using the drops after removing the lenses and using them while the lenses are still in.
DLG-SC-LOC-025-12-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will distinguish questions about use while wearing lenses at work from use after removing them. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-025-12-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-025-12-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらの受付では、レンズとの組合せについて判断できません。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-12-001-SHARED-07.translation: At this reception desk, we cannot determine compatibility with lenses.

DLG-SC-LOC-025-12-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-025-12-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 分かりました。受付の方へ「大丈夫」とだけ答えてもらいたいわけではありません。控えの名前だけで足りなければ、現物を持って来ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-12-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 受付に使用保証を求めず品名不足なら現物持参すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-12-001-SHARED-08.translation: Understood. I'm not asking the receptionist simply to tell me it's fine. If the name I've written down isn't enough, I'll bring the actual product.
DLG-SC-LOC-025-12-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you are not seeking a guarantee of safe use from reception and will bring the product if its name is insufficient. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-025-12-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-025-12-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: そのご希望もお伝えします。ほかに、先に知らせたいことはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-12-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll pass that on too. Is there anything else you'd like us to know in advance?

DLG-SC-LOC-025-12-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-025-12-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 薬剤師には、以前使った時にはレンズをしていなかったと伝えてください。今の状況で確認が必要だと分かったので、まず説明を聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-12-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 以前はレンズ未装用だった事実を申し送りし現在事情で専門説明を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-12-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please tell the pharmacist I wasn't wearing lenses when I used it before. I understand my current circumstances need to be checked, so I'll listen to the explanation first.
DLG-SC-LOC-025-12-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Have staff pass on that you did not wear lenses previously and say you will first hear the professional explanation for your current situation. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-025-12-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-025-12-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。それでは、薬剤師のご案内までこちらでお待ちください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-12-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please wait here until we guide you to the pharmacist. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-025-13-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-025-13-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらの黒い靴をお試しになりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-13-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like to try these black shoes?

DLG-SC-LOC-025-13-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-025-13-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 仕事用に探しています。丈夫そうに見えるので、現場で指定された保護具にもなるかと思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-13-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 丈夫に見える靴が職場指定保護具になるか相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-13-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'm looking for work shoes. They look sturdy, so I wondered if they could also serve as the protective equipment specified for my worksite.
DLG-SC-LOC-025-13-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether sturdy-looking shoes can serve as the protective equipment specified by your workplace. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-025-13-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-025-13-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらは普段用の靴です。見た目だけで職場の指定に合うとはお答えできません。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-13-001-SHARED-03.translation: These are everyday shoes. We cannot say they meet your workplace's requirements based only on appearance.

DLG-SC-LOC-025-13-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-025-13-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 黒くて厚い靴ならよいと思っていました。勤務先の指定を書いた物は今持っていないので、仕事用としては決めません。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-13-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 外観だけで決めず職場指定未持参のため購入を保留する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-13-001-SHARED-04.translation: I thought black, thick shoes would be enough. I don't have the written workplace requirements with me now, so I won't decide on them for work.
DLG-SC-LOC-025-13-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Postpone the purchase rather than decide by appearance because you do not have the workplace requirements. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-025-13-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-025-13-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 普段使いとして試されますか。それとも指定を確認してからにされますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-13-001-SHARED-05.translation: Would you like to try them for everyday use, or check the requirements first?

DLG-SC-LOC-025-13-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-025-13-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 指定を確認してからにします。試着して楽に歩けても、それだけで必要な性能がある証明にはならないですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-13-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 試着快適さは必要性能の証明ではないと理解し指定確認を優先する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-13-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll check the requirements first. Even if they're comfortable to walk in when tried on, that alone doesn't prove they have the required performance.
DLG-SC-LOC-025-13-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show you understand that comfort when trying them on does not prove required performance, and prioritize checking the specifications. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-025-13-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-025-13-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 職場から指定されている種類や表示が分かれば、売場で取扱いを確認できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-13-001-SHARED-07.translation: If you know the type and markings your workplace requires, we can check whether a sales department carries them.

DLG-SC-LOC-025-13-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-025-13-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 上司には、必要な種類と商品で確認する表示を聞きます。この靴を買った後に、現場で使えることにしてもらう頼み方はしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-13-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 上司へ種類表示を聞き購入品に合わせ職場条件変更を求めない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-13-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll ask my supervisor what type is needed and which markings to check on the product. I won't buy these shoes first and then ask for them to be treated as usable on site.
DLG-SC-LOC-025-13-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask your supervisor about the required type and markings rather than request changes to workplace conditions to suit a purchased item. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-025-13-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-025-13-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 分かりました。本日は商品を取り置きなさいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-13-001-SHARED-09.translation: Understood. Would you like us to reserve this item today?

DLG-SC-LOC-025-13-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-025-13-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: この品に合うよう指定を変えるつもりはないので、取り置きもせず戻します。条件を確認してから、扱う売場を改めて探します。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-13-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 未確認品の取置もせず返し条件確認後に適切な売場を探す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-13-001-SHARED-10.translation: I don't intend to change the requirements to fit this product, so I won't reserve it; I'll hand it back. After checking the conditions, I'll look again for the appropriate sales department.
DLG-SC-LOC-025-13-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Return the unverified item without reserving it and seek an appropriate sales department after checking the requirements. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-025-13-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-025-13-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お預かりします。それでは、指定をご確認になってからご相談ください。お気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-13-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll take it back. Please consult us again after checking the specifications. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-025-14-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-025-14-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お部屋とは別に、通話をする場所をお探しですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-14-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking for somewhere to make a call outside your room?

DLG-SC-LOC-025-14-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-025-14-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。家族が部屋で眠っています。仕事の通話を三十分ほど予定していて、起こさずに済む場所を相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-14-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 眠る同室家族を起こさず三十分仕事通話の場所を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-14-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. My family is sleeping in the room. I have a work call planned for about thirty minutes and would like advice on a place where I won't wake them.
DLG-SC-LOC-025-14-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for somewhere to make a thirty-minute work call without waking the family sharing your room. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-025-14-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-025-14-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 利用できる場所と条件を確認します。会議の映像も使われますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-14-001-SHARED-03.translation: I'll check the available places and their conditions of use. Will you also use video for the meeting?

DLG-SC-LOC-025-14-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-025-14-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 音声だけです。ただ、仕事先の名前が話に出るので、人が多いロビーで大声を出すのは避けたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-14-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 音声のみだが仕事先情報のため混雑ロビーの大声通話を避ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-14-001-SHARED-04.translation: Audio only. But the names of my work contacts will come up, so I'd like to avoid talking loudly in a crowded lobby.
DLG-SC-LOC-025-14-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say the call is audio only, but you want to avoid a loud call in a crowded lobby because work-related names will be discussed. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-025-14-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-025-14-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 小さい打合せ室の空きを確認できます。静かさや通信の安定までお約束することはできません。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-14-001-SHARED-05.translation: We can check the availability of a small meeting room. We cannot guarantee quietness or a stable connection.

DLG-SC-LOC-025-14-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-025-14-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 確認をお願いします。部屋が空いているだけで通話できると決めず、利用料と時間、通話をしてよいかも聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-14-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 空室と通話可否料金時間を分けて確認を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-14-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please check. I won't assume I can make a call just because a room is available. I'd like to ask about the fee, time, and whether calls are permitted too.
DLG-SC-LOC-025-14-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask separately about room availability, permission for calls, fees, and usage time. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-025-14-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-025-14-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 三十分の利用が可能です。こちらが料金と利用の案内です。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-14-001-SHARED-07.translation: It is available for thirty minutes. Here are the fees and usage instructions.

DLG-SC-LOC-025-14-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-025-14-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: この料金で利用します。家族へは部屋を出ることを先に伝え、急に姿が見えなくなったと心配させないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-14-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 案内料金で利用し家族に移動を先に知らせると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-14-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll use it at this price. I'll tell my family before leaving the room so they don't worry that I've suddenly disappeared.
DLG-SC-LOC-025-14-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Accept the stated fee and say you will tell your family about moving beforehand. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-025-14-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-025-14-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 終了時刻になりましたら、鍵を受付へお返しください。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-14-001-SHARED-09.translation: At the end of your time, please return the key to reception.

DLG-SC-LOC-025-14-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-025-14-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 返す時刻を確認しました。仕事先にも別の場所へ移ると連絡し、つながりにくければ通話の仕方を相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-14-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 鍵返却時刻を確認し仕事先へ移動と接続不調時の再相談を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-14-001-SHARED-10.translation: I've checked the return time. I'll also tell my work contact I'm moving elsewhere and discuss how to handle the call if the connection is poor.
DLG-SC-LOC-025-14-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm the key return time and tell your work contact about the move and discussing another approach if the connection is poor. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-025-14-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-025-14-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご利用後は受付へお立ち寄りください。それでは、お仕事のご準備へどうぞ。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-14-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please stop by reception after using the room. Now please go ahead with preparing for your work. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-025-15-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-025-15-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 展示の説明で、気になる言葉はありましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-15-001-SHARED-01.translation: Was there a word in the exhibit explanation that caught your attention?

DLG-SC-LOC-025-15-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-025-15-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この展示を友人へ説明したいです。屋台という言葉を見て、祭で食べ物を売る店の話かと思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-15-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 展示の屋台という語を飲食店と解釈したと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-15-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like to explain this exhibit to a friend. I saw the word 'yatai' and thought it meant a stall selling food at a festival.
DLG-SC-LOC-025-15-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you interpreted 'yatai' in the exhibit as a food stall and ask about it. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-025-15-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-025-15-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この説明での屋台は、展示されている曳山を指しています。食べ物の売場を案内する文ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-15-001-SHARED-03.translation: In this explanation, 'yatai' refers to the festival float on display. It is not a sentence directing you to food stalls.

DLG-SC-LOC-025-15-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-025-15-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 同じ屋台でも、この文では食べ物の店という意味ではないのですね。屋台で何を買えるか友人へ聞くところでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-15-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 展示内の意味を理解し売物質問を友人へ送る前に修正する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-15-001-SHARED-04.translation: So even though it's the same word, it doesn't mean a food stall in this sentence. I was about to ask my friend what we could buy at the 'yatai.'
DLG-SC-LOC-025-15-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show you understand the meaning in the exhibit and correct yourself before sending your friend a question about things for sale. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-025-15-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-025-15-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: どの部分を紹介される予定でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-15-001-SHARED-05.translation: Which part are you planning to introduce?

DLG-SC-LOC-025-15-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-025-15-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 上の飾りが印象に残りました。食べ物の値段ではなく、飾りの色と形を言葉にして紹介したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-15-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 売価でなく印象に残った上部装飾の色形を紹介したいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-15-001-SHARED-06.translation: The decorations at the top made an impression on me. Rather than food prices, I'd like to describe their colors and shapes.
DLG-SC-LOC-025-15-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you want to describe the colors and shapes of the memorable upper decorations, not prices of goods. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-025-15-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-025-15-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 見えた部分と、まだ説明を読んでいない仕組みを分けてお伝えになるとよいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-15-001-SHARED-07.translation: It would be good to distinguish what you saw from the mechanism you haven't read about yet.

DLG-SC-LOC-025-15-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-025-15-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: そうします。動く仕組みを知っているふりで話さず、まず青い飾りが見えたという自分の感想を伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-15-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 未読の仕組みは断定せず青い装飾の自分の印象として伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-15-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll do that. I won't talk as though I know how it moves; first I'll give my own impression that I saw blue decorations.
DLG-SC-LOC-025-15-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Avoid asserting how the unread mechanism works and give your own impression of the blue decorations. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-025-15-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-025-15-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 説明文の呼び名も、友人が分かるように添えられます。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-15-001-SHARED-09.translation: You can also add the name used in the explanation so your friend understands.

DLG-SC-LOC-025-15-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-025-15-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 「曳山の展示を見た」と最初に言います。屋台とだけ送って食事へ誘っていると誤解されないよう、展示の話だと分かる文にします。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-15-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 曳山展示と明記して屋台だけで食事の誘いと誤解させない文にする。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-15-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll begin by saying I saw an exhibit of a festival float. I'll make it clear I'm talking about an exhibit, so simply sending 'yatai' doesn't make them think I'm inviting them to eat.
DLG-SC-LOC-025-15-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explicitly say it is a festival-float exhibit so 'yatai' alone is not mistaken for an invitation to eat. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-025-15-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-025-15-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 呼び名を整理できましたね。それでは、引き続き飾りもご覧ください。ご見学ありがとうございました。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-15-001-SHARED-11.translation: You've clarified the terminology. Please continue looking at the decorations. Thank you for viewing the exhibit. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-025-16-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-025-16-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 鞄の修理をご希望でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-16-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like your bag repaired?

DLG-SC-LOC-025-16-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-025-16-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 内側の布が裂けています。明後日から旅行に使いたいので、預ける前に間に合うか知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-16-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 内布裂けの鞄を明後日旅行に使うため預ける前に納期を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-16-001-SHARED-02.translation: The inner lining is torn. I'd like to use it for a trip starting the day after tomorrow, so I want to know whether it can be ready in time before leaving it here.
DLG-SC-LOC-025-16-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about the completion time before leaving a bag with torn lining for a trip the day after tomorrow. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-025-16-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-025-16-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 状態を見て、作業の日数をご案内します。外側の持ち手にも不具合はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-16-001-SHARED-03.translation: We'll examine its condition and advise how many days the work takes. Is there also a problem with the outer handle?

DLG-SC-LOC-025-16-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-025-16-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 持ち手は普段どおりです。内側から小さい物が入り込むので、見た目だけでなく、物を取り出しやすくしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-16-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 持ち手不具合なしと内布奥へ小物が入り使いにくい目的を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-16-001-SHARED-04.translation: The handle is as usual. Small items slip through the inner lining, so it's not just about appearance; I want to make it easier to retrieve things.
DLG-SC-LOC-025-16-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that the handle has no problem and small items slipping behind the lining make it inconvenient. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-025-16-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-025-16-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 今回は、明後日までの仕上がりには対応できません。旅行後のお預かりなら日程をご相談できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-16-001-SHARED-05.translation: We cannot have this repair finished by the day after tomorrow. We can discuss a schedule if you leave it after your trip.

DLG-SC-LOC-025-16-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-025-16-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 間に合わないと分かったので、急いで適当な直し方に変えてもらうのはやめます。旅行は別の鞄を使います。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-16-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 納期不能を受け粗い急ぎ修理を求めず別鞄で旅行を選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-16-001-SHARED-06.translation: Now that I know it won't be ready in time, I won't ask you to change to a rushed, makeshift repair. I'll use a different bag for the trip.
DLG-SC-LOC-025-16-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Accept the impossible deadline, avoid requesting a rough rush repair, and choose a different travel bag. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-025-16-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-025-16-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この鞄を、今日お預けになりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-16-001-SHARED-07.translation: Will you leave this bag with us today?

DLG-SC-LOC-025-16-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-025-16-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今日は持ち帰ります。中に入れた物を家で全部出し、裂けた布の奥に小物が残っていないか自分で確認してから預けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-16-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 当日預けず持帰り内容物と内布奥の小物を確認して後日預ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-16-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll take it home today. I'll empty everything out at home and check for small items remaining behind the torn fabric myself before leaving it for repair.
DLG-SC-LOC-025-16-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will take it home rather than leave it today, check its contents and behind the lining, and leave it another day. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-025-16-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-025-16-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: お持ちになる際には、ご希望の仕上がりもお知らせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-16-001-SHARED-09.translation: When you bring it in, please tell us the result you'd like as well.

DLG-SC-LOC-025-16-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-025-16-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 旅行から戻ったら、内布を直して小物が潜り込まないようにしたいと改めて相談します。今日の持帰りが修理完了ということではないですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-16-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 旅行後の内布修理希望を整理し今日相談だけで未修理と確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-16-001-SHARED-10.translation: After returning from my trip, I'll consult you again about repairing the lining so small items no longer slip behind it. Taking it home today doesn't mean the repair is complete, correct?
DLG-SC-LOC-025-16-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Clarify your wish for lining repair after the trip and confirm that today's consultation does not mean it has been repaired. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-025-16-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-025-16-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい、今日はご相談のみです。それでは、お気をつけて。旅行後のご相談をお待ちしております。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-16-001-SHARED-11.translation: Correct, today is a consultation only. Take care, and we look forward to consulting with you after your trip.

DLG-SC-LOC-025-17-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-025-17-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 展示について、ご質問を用意されていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-17-001-SHARED-01.translation: Have you prepared questions about the exhibit?

DLG-SC-LOC-025-17-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-025-17-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 自由研究で取材したいです。質問を十個持ってきましたが、今、全部答えていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-17-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 自由研究の十質問へ取材対応できるか担当へ尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-17-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like to interview you for an independent research project. I brought ten questions. Could you answer all of them now?
DLG-SC-LOC-025-17-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask the staff member whether they can answer ten interview questions for an independent research project. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-025-17-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-025-17-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 今は別のご案内もあるので、長い取材には対応できません。一つなら、この場で伺えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-17-001-SHARED-03.translation: We also have other visitors to guide now, so we can't accommodate a long interview. We can hear one question here.

DLG-SC-LOC-025-17-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-025-17-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 十個を急いで読み上げるのではなく、一つに絞ります。展示をどう選んで並べたか、担当の方の考えを聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-17-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 質問数を一つへ絞り展示配置を考えた理由を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-17-001-SHARED-04.translation: Rather than rushing through all ten aloud, I'll narrow it to one. I'd like to hear your thoughts on how the exhibits were selected and arranged.
DLG-SC-LOC-025-17-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Narrow the questions to one and ask about the reasoning behind the exhibit arrangement. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-025-17-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-025-17-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この展示の紹介を担当した立場から、短くお話しできます。研究者個人の見解を代表する話ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-17-001-SHARED-05.translation: I can speak briefly from my position as the person responsible for introducing this exhibit. This does not represent individual researchers' views.

DLG-SC-LOC-025-17-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-025-17-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 担当された展示紹介の考えとして記録します。館全体や全研究者の意見と広げて書くのは避けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-17-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 展示紹介担当の発言範囲を館全体研究者全員の総意へ広げない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-17-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll record it as your thinking in introducing the exhibit you handled. I'll avoid extending it into the opinion of the entire institution or all its researchers.
DLG-SC-LOC-025-17-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Do not broaden the exhibit introduction staff member's statement into the consensus of the institution or all researchers. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-025-17-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-025-17-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらでは、見た物を比べやすい順序を考えて並べました。残りの質問は、改めて問い合わせ方法を確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-17-001-SHARED-07.translation: Here, we arranged things in an order that makes the objects you see easy to compare. Please check separately how to inquire about the remaining questions.

DLG-SC-LOC-025-17-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-025-17-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。今の説明を、自分の言葉で要点だけ書いてもよいですか。話していない内容まで引用の形で足したくありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-17-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 要点を自分の言葉で記録し未発言内容を引用へ足さないと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-17-001-SHARED-08.translation: Thank you. May I record just the main point of that explanation in my own words? I don't want to add things you haven't said as though they were quotations.
DLG-SC-LOC-025-17-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will record the main point in your own words without adding unspoken material to a quotation. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-025-17-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-025-17-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 要点を読み返して、私がお話しした範囲と合うか今確認できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-17-001-SHARED-09.translation: You can read back the main point now to check that it matches the scope of what I said.

DLG-SC-LOC-025-17-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-025-17-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 「比べて見る順序を考えた」と書きました。ほかの九問は答えていただいたことにせず、後の問い合わせ用に残します。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-17-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 配置理由の要約を確認し未回答九問は回答済み扱いせず残す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-17-001-SHARED-10.translation: I've written that you considered an order for comparative viewing. I won't treat the other nine questions as answered; I'll keep them for a later inquiry.
DLG-SC-LOC-025-17-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check your summary of the reason for the arrangement and retain the nine unanswered questions without treating them as answered. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-025-17-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-025-17-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その要点で結構です。それでは、残りの質問は受付で方法をお確かめください。ご研究を楽しんでください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-17-001-SHARED-11.translation: That main point is fine. Please check at reception how to ask the remaining questions. Enjoy your research. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-025-18-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-025-18-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 橋を渡る散策のご案内をご覧ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-18-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking at the walking guide for crossing the bridge?

DLG-SC-LOC-025-18-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-025-18-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。連れが途中で高さを怖く感じました。向こうまで行く予定でしたが、無理に進ませず戻れる道を相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-18-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 橋の高さを怖がる連れを無理に進ませず帰路を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-18-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. Partway through, my companion became frightened by the height. We planned to go all the way across, but I don't want to force them onward, so I'd like advice on a route back.
DLG-SC-LOC-025-18-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for a return route without forcing your companion, who is afraid of the bridge's height, to continue. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-025-18-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-025-18-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 今、お連れの方はどちらにいらっしゃいますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-025-18-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-025-18-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 案内所の前で一緒に座っています。私だけ先へ行って、後で追いかけて来るように頼んだわけではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-18-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 同席待機中で本人だけ先行し追わせたわけではないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-18-001-SHARED-04.translation: We're sitting together in front of the information center. I haven't gone ahead alone and asked them to catch up later.
DLG-SC-LOC-025-18-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you are waiting together, not that you went ahead alone and asked them to follow. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-025-18-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-025-18-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 散策の予定を変えるなら、この案内の戻る経路を確認できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-18-001-SHARED-05.translation: If you're changing your walk plans, you can check the return route on this guide.

DLG-SC-LOC-025-18-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-025-18-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 戻る方を見ます。向こう岸の店で昼食を予約しているので、道だけでなく予約先への連絡も必要です。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-18-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 帰路確認と向岸の昼食予約先連絡を両方必要と述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-18-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll look at the return route. We have a lunch reservation at a restaurant on the far bank, so we need to contact them as well as check the route.
DLG-SC-LOC-025-18-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you need both to check the return route and contact the lunch reservation on the far bank. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-025-18-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-025-18-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: お店の予約は、先方へ直接ご相談ください。ここで取消しをお受けすることはできません。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-18-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please discuss the restaurant reservation directly with them. We cannot accept a cancellation here.

DLG-SC-LOC-025-18-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-025-18-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 先方へ事情を伝えます。橋を渡れなかったことを連れのせいとして話さず、二人で予定を変えたと言います。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-18-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 予約先へ本人連絡し同行者責任ではなく二人の予定変更と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-18-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll tell them the circumstances. I won't blame my companion for not crossing the bridge; I'll say the two of us changed our plans.
DLG-SC-LOC-025-18-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Contact the restaurant yourself and explain it as a change of plans by both of you, without blaming your companion. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-025-18-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-025-18-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 戻る経路は確認できましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-18-001-SHARED-09.translation: Have you checked the return route?

DLG-SC-LOC-025-18-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-025-18-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 確認できました。店へも遅れて向かうのでなく今日は行けないと連絡しました。連れと同じ速さで戻り、別の場所で休みます。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-18-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 帰路と当日訪問中止連絡を終え連れの速さで戻り休むと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-18-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I've also told the restaurant we can't come today, rather than saying we'll arrive late. I'll return at my companion's pace and rest somewhere else.
DLG-SC-LOC-025-18-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you have checked the route, notified the restaurant you will not visit today, and will return at your companion's pace to rest. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-025-18-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-025-18-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: どうぞお二人で無理なくお戻りください。それでは、足元にお気をつけて。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-025-18-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please return together at a comfortable pace. Watch your footing. Goodbye.
